title: Realize a localized coordinate-prime ring chart as a quasi-finite scheme chart
statement: Let $\rho:R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $\mathfrak q_A\subset A$ be prime and $\mathfrak p=\rho^{-1}(\mathfrak q_A)$, let $f\in R\setminus\mathfrak p$, $d\in A\setminus\mathfrak q_A$, and suppose $\rho(f)$ is invertible in $A_d$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let $0\le r\le n$ be integers and let $\theta:C=R_f[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\to A_d$ be an $R_f$-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] of finite type and quasi-finite at every prime [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra, def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime]. Assume $\theta^{-1}(\mathfrak q_A A_d)=P=(\mathfrak pR_f,x_{r+1},\ldots,x_n)$. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}A$, let $p:Z\to S$ be induced by $\rho$, and let $z\in Z$ correspond to $\mathfrak q_A$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The principal open subschemes $S_0=D(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}R_f$ and $Z_0=D(d)\cong\operatorname{Spec}A_d$ contain $p(z)$ and $z$, respectively, and $Z_0\subseteq p^{-1}(S_0)$. The morphism $q:Z_0\to\mathbf A^n_{S_0}=\operatorname{Spec}C$ induced by $\theta$ [def-sbc-affine-space] is over $S_0$, is of finite type and quasi-finite [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, pqf-def-quasifinite], and has finite discrete scheme fibres. For $t=q(z)$, one has $t=P$ and an isomorphism of $\kappa(p(z))$-algebras $\kappa(t)\cong\kappa(p(z))(u_1,\ldots,u_r)$ [def-weil-residue-field], where the right side is the fraction field of the polynomial ring in $r$ independent variables (the base field itself if $r=0$). No fibre-dimension or finite-presentation hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Finite type and primewise isolated algebra fibres imply that each compact fibre spectrum is discrete and therefore finite. Algebra.QuasiFinite.iff_finite_comap_preimage_singleton gives a quasi-finite ring map. The affine Spec criteria yield locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite, and affine maps are quasi-compact. Transport across basicOpenIsoSpecAway and AffineSpace.SpecIso.

Membership in the two basic opens is exactly hf and hd. For every x in D(d), its prime in A_d does not contain the unit rho(f), so x maps into D(f). Apply AffineSpace.SpecIso_inv_over, Spec functoriality and htheta for the equation over Spec R_f. Compose with Spec(R_f <- R) and use the localization lift equation and basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap to obtain the structural equation over Spec R.

Local quasi-finiteness makes each asFiber point isolated, proving the project IsQuasiFinite predicate together with finite type and quasi-compactness. The finite-fibre theorem and Scheme.Hom.discreteTopology_fiber_and_quasiFiniteAt give finite discrete scheme fibres.

The structural equation for basicOpenIsoSpecAway identifies the contraction of the localized marked prime with q_A. Extension of contraction is the identity for a localization, so that prime equals q_A A_d. Cancel AffineSpace.SpecIso with its inverse and use hprime to identify the image prime. Evaluate the structural equation over Spec R to identify its base point. Apply the coordinate-prime residue-field theorem at this point, replacing its base prime by the identified one.
